provenance.source: Wet inkomstenbelasting 2001; Belastingdienst tables 'Tabel algemene heffingskorting 2026' and 'Tabel arbeidskorting 2026'; PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries, Netherlands
provenance.notes: The arbeidskorting segments were read from the Belastingdienst's own 2026 table on 31 August 2026. Box 1 brackets came from PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries and the algemene heffingskorting figures from a search summary of the Belastingdienst table rather than the table itself.

verificationTodo: Confirm the algemene heffingskorting maximum of EUR 3,115, the taper start of EUR 29,736 and the taper rate of 6.398% against the Belastingdienst table directly.
Confirm the three Box 1 bracket limits for 2026.
omissions: Only Box 1 employment income is modelled. Box 2 (substantial interest) and Box 3 (savings and investments) are out of scope.
The 30% ruling for incoming employees is not modelled, and it changes the answer substantially for those who qualify.
Mortgage interest relief and the eigenwoningforfait are not modelled.
Credits for people at or above AOW pension age use different amounts and are not modelled.
The inkomensafhankelijke combinatiekorting for working parents is not modelled.

box1Scale.note: The first bracket rate of 35.75% is mostly national insurance: 27.65 points of it are premiums for AOW, Anw and Wlz, and only 8.10 points are income tax. It is withheld as one combined loonheffing.

algemeneHeffingskorting.note: A credit against tax, not an allowance against income. It is withdrawn at 6.398 cents per euro above EUR 29,736, which silently adds that much to the marginal rate across a very wide band.

arbeidskorting.note: Four segments: three building up at different speeds, then a long withdrawal. Combined with the algemene heffingskorting taper this is why Dutch marginal rates in the middle of the income range are far above the headline bracket rate.

donations.note: Ordinary gifts are deductible only above a threshold of 1% of income and only up to 10% of income. Periodic gifts recorded in a deed have no threshold, which this app does not model.

regions.name: Netherlands
regions.note: Dutch income tax has no provincial or municipal component.

inputSchema.label: Bruto salaris (gross pay, per month)
inputSchema.help: Gross monthly salary. If you receive holiday allowance (vakantiegeld) or a thirteenth month, add it to the month it is paid.

inputSchema.label: Loonheffing withheld (per month)
inputSchema.help: The combined wage tax and national insurance your employer withheld. Used only for the annual comparison.

inputSchema.label: Lijfrente or annuity premiums paid
inputSchema.help: Deductible only within your jaarruimte, the annual pension gap. This app does not compute your jaarruimte, so enter only the amount you can actually deduct.

inputSchema.label: Gifts to ANBI charities
inputSchema.help: Ordinary gifts count only above 1% of your income and only up to 10% of it. A periodic gift set out in a notarial or private deed escapes the threshold entirely; that is not modelled here.
